R = required ratio
matched required / total required

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 220px; text-align: center;

span.p:
N = nice-to-have ratio

span.p:

span.p:

1 if same city or remote, else 0

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 220px; text-align: center;

span.p:
score = 70·R + 15·N
+ 10·E + 5·L
exact, clamped to 0–100
stored unrounded
